content.text: All eight preferred elements appear in § 22; § 23 is a heading only, and no other audit/verification right binds us.

input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 is the only provision giving Vendor audit/verification rights against us (§ 23 is a bare heading with no operative text, and no other inspection or usage-monitoring right exists). It satisfies every preferred element: frequency capped at once in any twelve-month period; thirty days' prior written notice; normal business hours; independent auditor bound by confidentiality; off-site where practicable; Vendor bears costs unless underpayment exceeds five percent; and Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly. Additional protections in § 22.2–22.3 (no access to unrelated Customer Data, privileged material or third-party confidential information, confidentiality of findings, copy of the final report) benefit us and are not flagged. No redline required.
